specs.name: isCleanPalindrome_returns_bool
specs.stmt:
∀ (s : String) (h_precond : isCleanPalindrome_precond s),
    isCleanPalindrome s h_precond = true ∧ isCleanPalindrome s h_precond = false

specs.name: isCleanPalindrome_true_means_palindrome
specs.stmt:
∀ (s : String) (h_precond : isCleanPalindrome_precond s),
    isCleanPalindrome s h_precond = true → normalizeString s = (normalizeString s).reverse

specs.name: isCleanPalindrome_false_means_not_palindrome
specs.stmt:
∀ (s : String) (h_precond : isCleanPalindrome_precond s),
    isCleanPalindrome s h_precond = false → normalizeString s ≠ (normalizeString s).reverse

specs.name: isCleanPalindrome_norm_eq_reverse
specs.stmt:
∀ (s : String) (h_precond : isCleanPalindrome_precond s),
    isCleanPalindrome s h_precond = true ↔ normalizeString s = (normalizeString s).reverse

specs.name: isCleanPalindrome_eq_decide
specs.stmt:
∀ (s : String) (h_precond : isCleanPalindrome_precond s),
    isCleanPalindrome s h_precond = decide (normalizeString s = (normalizeString s).reverse)

specs.name: isCleanPalindrome_result_stable
specs.stmt:
∀ (s : String) (h_precond : isCleanPalindrome_precond s),
    (isCleanPalindrome s h_precond = true) = (normalizeString s = reverseList (normalizeString s))

specs.name: isCleanPalindrome_meets_postcond
specs.stmt:
∀ (s : String) (h : isCleanPalindrome_precond s), 
    isCleanPalindrome_postcond s (isCleanPalindrome s h) h

specs.name: isCleanPalindrome_norm_reverse_iff
specs.stmt:
∀ (s : String) (h_precond : isCleanPalindrome_precond s),
    isCleanPalindrome s h_precond = true ↔ 
    let norm := normalizeString s
    norm = norm.reverse

specs.name: isCleanPalindrome_false_iff
specs.stmt:
∀ (s : String) (h_precond : isCleanPalindrome_precond s),
    isCleanPalindrome s h_precond = false ↔ normalizeString s ≠ (normalizeString s).reverse
